result.title: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
result.summary: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. To enable task-conditioned risk supervision and tackle challenge (2), we conduct matched counterfactual replays of each original experience and its minimally neutralized counterpart from the same task and environment checkpoint, deriving separate risk labels from differences in attack success and legitimate task completion. To tackle challenge (3) at inference time, ExpGuard repairs candidate experiences flagged as high-risk by the graph-based predictor at retrieval and re-predicts their risks before they enter the agent's active experience context. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpGuard in identifying risky experiences and defending agents against experience corruption.

AI.brief_summary: 针对长程 LLM agent 把历史轨迹蒸馏为可复用经验时可能被错误或对抗信息污染的问题，ExpGuard 用任务条件下的异构图结合来源与执行依赖预测风险，并通过匹配的反事实重放生成风险标签，在检索时修复高风险经验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“反事实重放差分标注”和“检索时风险门控与修复后再进入上下文”的机制，可能为 latent/视觉证据注入的因果贡献分配与筛选提供借鉴，但需核查是否可迁移到单次 VLM 推理状态。
